mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) increases bradykinin levels, creating risk of hypertensive crisis, angioedema, and severe hypotension; additionally, sacubitril's valsartan component with MAOI poses hypertensive crisis risk.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use sacubitril/valsartan with MAOIs including isocarboxazid due to uncontrollable hypertensive crisis and angioedema risk; allow minimum 14-day washout after MAOI discontinuation before initiating sacubitril.
